subject: Acme POC: ownership lanes, procurement steps, and milestone timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acme POC kickoff recap & ownership lanes

Sara — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Goal: Validate low-latency inference for Acme's customer-facing search (>=95th pctile latency < 120ms) and reduce per-query cost vs current provider by ~30%.
- Scope: 2 core flows (text search, related-recommendations), sample dataset (100k queries), and an integration sandbox in your AWS account.

Proposed success criteria (attached spreadsheet has metrics):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 120ms at observed QPS (pilot baseline included)
- Quality: precision@10 on sample evaluation set within 5% of current baseline
- Reliability: 99.5% availability during test window
- Cost: estimated unit cost improvement >= 25% measured across the pilot workload

Ownership lanes we need to lock down (please confirm owners):
- Infra (customer cloud + networking): Acme-owned — who on your side will be the AWS admin for the sandbox?
- App integration (sdk, auth, routing): Acme app eng -> primary contact?
- Security / compliance review (SaaS data flows, retention, logs): Acme security + Redwood SE (Rishi)
- Procurement / PO / contracting: Acme procurement contact

Internal roles from Redwood:
- Jordan Blake (sales) — commercial lead, timeline/approval coordination
- Monica Patel (solutions engineering) — technical kickoff, onboarding, run trials
- Rishi Malhotra (security) — security questionnaire and evidence review

Attachments: Acme_POC_Success_Criteria_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with thresholds and evaluation plan)

Ask: can you confirm the owners for the four lanes above, and indicate a target 6-week window (we proposed Nov 15 -> Dec 24) or suggest alternatives? Once owners are confirmed Monica will schedule the technical kickoff and circulate an onboarding checklist.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Kumar <raj.kumar@acme.com>, Thomas Greene <thomas.greene@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap & ownership lanes

Jordan — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming owners below and a couple notes from our side: 

Confirmed owners (Acme):
- Infra (AWS sandbox & network): Raj Kumar, Senior Cloud Engineer (raj.kumar@acme.com) — he will provision the sandbox and open connectivity to Redwood test endpoints.
- App integration: Priya Nair, Platform Lead (via Raj's team) — she'll own the SDK integration and auth flow. Please loop her on the technical kickoff.
- Security review: Thomas Greene, Security Engineering (thomas.greene@acme.com) — he'll coordinate on SOC2 evidence and retention policy questions.
- Procurement / contracting: Thomas Greene is also handling procurement intake for pilot POs this quarter (he'll route to finance).

Timeline: Nov 15 start is possible, but Raj asked for sandbox network prep time — propose Nov 15 -> Dec 22 (6 weeks) with an internal milestone on Nov 26 for basic connectivity and authentication tests.

I've attached a network diagram (acme_network_diagram_v3.pdf) showing where the sandbox will live and the guardrails for egress — Raj will review with Monica in the kickoff.

We'll review the success criteria spreadsheet and come back with any clarifying questions by Friday.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Lopez
Director, Product Management
Acme Corp
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Acme POC — proposed RACI, checkpoints, and action owners

Internal alignment (draft RACI and schedule) — please review and flag issues. We'll send to Acme after we get the sandbox owner confirmed by Raj.

RACI (draft) 
- Infra sandbox provisioning: Responsible: Raj (Acme) | Consulted: Monica | Informed: Jordan
- Network access & peering: Responsible: Raj (Acme) | Consulted: Monica, Rishi | Informed: Jordan
- SDK integration & auth: Responsible: Priya (Acme) | Responsible (Redwood): Monica (assist) | Consulted: Jordan
- Security evidence & questionnaire: Responsible: Thomas (Acme) | Responsible (Redwood): Rishi | Informed: Jordan
- PO & procurement signoff: Responsible: Thomas (Acme) | Informed: Jordan

Milestones and checkpoints (tentative):
- Nov 15: sandbox live + initial connectivity smoke test (owner: Raj / Monica)
- Nov 26: first ingestion of sample dataset and baseline latency run (owner: Monica)
- Dec 7: midpoint quality review and cost estimates updated (owner: Monica/Jordan)
- Dec 20: final evaluation results and go/no-go decision (owner: Jordan)

Immediate internal actions:
1) Monica: prepare onboarding document and runbook (deliverable: onboarding-runbook.md linked in doc) — due Nov 12
2) Rishi: draft answers for Acme's security questionnaire and identify any additional evidence required — due Nov 13
3) Jordan: confirm commercial terms to support PO submission and share the draft SOW with Thomas when ready

Notes: we should propose a short weekly 30-min sync (Mon/Wed) for the first 3 weeks to keep momentum. Also recommend we offer a 2-hour block for a security walkthrough with Thomas during week 1.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Raj Kumar <raj.kumar@acme.com>, Thomas Greene <thomas.greene@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap & ownership lanes

Thanks, Sara — that lines up well. Quick consolidated next steps and asks so nothing falls through the cracks: 

Confirmed owners: Raj (infra), Priya (app/integration), Thomas (security + procurement). Redwood leads: Monica (onboarding & trials), Rishi (security), Jordan (commercial/decision).

Actionables (owners & dates):
- Raj: provision sandbox and share AWS account details and security group rules by Nov 12 (blocking item for Nov 15 start).
- Monica: onboarding runbook and checklist to Acme by Nov 12 (includes sample dataset instructions and auth steps).
- Rishi: security Q&A bundle to Thomas by Nov 13 (we'll request SOC2 scoping if needed).
- Thomas: confirm procurement contact and whether a PO or MSA amendment is required by Nov 12.
- Jordan: confirm commercial terms (pricing for 6-week pilot) and circulate draft SOW by Nov 10.

Proposed cadence: weekly 30-min sync starting Nov 16 (Tuesdays 9:00am PT) with an initial 90-min technical kickoff during the week of Nov 15. Please reply with any date conflicts or if you prefer a different cadence.

Attachments referenced: Acme_POC_Success_Criteria_v1.xlsx, acme_network_diagram_v3.pdf

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting started. If we can get Raj and Thomas items done by Nov 12 we can keep the Nov 15 target.
